title: Desperate Creatures
start: Speak to the Curator north of the Burthorpe lodestone.

recommended.t: Activated Burthorpe lodestone and Anachronia lodestone
Travelling to east of Anachronia near Moksha ritual site with Orthen teleportation device if completed Know Thy Measure mystery
Travelling to Rex Matriarchs by using the War's Retreat boss portal or Max Guild combat portal
Slayer cape for fast teleports to Spria and Laniakea
Eastern Anachronia Teleport and runes to cast it, or the Eastern Anachronia teleport tablet

rewards.t: Colossi & the time of colossi, written by Charos as Reldo, that details some aspects of colossi.
Reldo's ages seventeenth edition, written by Reldo and revised by Charos, that details major events that define the Ages of Gielinor.
This 17th edition is updated with discoveries found with the expedition to Anachronia.

steps.t: Speak to the Curator just north of Burthorpe lodestone. [Chat: ? Talk about 'Desperate Creatures'. › Accept › 3 What do I need to do first?]

sub.t: Slayer cape teleport to Turael/Spria is a good option as you'll need to teleport a few times.

steps.t: Teleport to Anachronia and run west.
Use the Tome of tracking to find all four flowers.
After the dialogue between Hannibus and Vindicta teleport back to Burthorpe and speak to the Curator. [Chat: ? Talk about 'Desperate Creatures'. › 1 Talk about your progress.]
Talk to the Curator again for the next task. [Chat: ? Talk about 'Desperate Creatures'. › 1 Talk about your progress.]
Teleport to Anachronia.
Find the 4 shrubberies around the camp using the tome.
Finish the dialogue with Mr Mordaut and teleport back to Burthorpe and speak to the Curator. [Chat: ? Talk about Desperate Creatures. › 1 Talk about your progress.]
Talk to the Curator again for the next task. [Chat: ? Talk about Desperate Creatures. › 1 Talk about your progress.]
Teleport to Anachronia and navigate to the Anachronia Swamp Fortress.

sub.t: Teleport to the Xolo dig site using the Orthen teleportation device or teleport to Laniakea via Slayer cape.

steps.t: Alternatively exit Anachronia base camp to the north down the stairs, not via the Agility shortcut.

sub.t: Run south past the lampenfloras while staying as far west as possible.

steps.t: Find all four mushrooms.
Finish the dialogue with Zaros and teleport back to Burthorpe and speak to the Curator. [Chat: ? Talk about Desperate Creatures. › 1 Talk about your progress.]
Talk to the Curator again for the next task. [Chat: ? Talk about Desperate Creatures. › 1 Talk about your progress.]
Teleport to Anachronia and navigate to an area south of the liverworts and north of the lampenfloras.

sub.t: The fastest way to get there is by teleporting to Anachronia and running slightly east to use the Orthen teleportation device. Then teleporting to the Moksha ritual site Key press | M and then exiting and running north-east.
Alternatively, leave Anachronia base camp to the north down the stairs, not via the Agility shortcut. Run east to the liverworts. Run south towards the lampenfloras.

steps.t: Find all four insects.
Finish the dialogue with Charos and Thok and teleport back to Burthorpe and speak to the Curator. [Chat: ? Talk about Desperate Creatures. › 1 Talk about your progress.]
Talk to the Curator again for the next task. [Chat: ? Talk about Desperate Creatures. › 1 Talk about your progress.]
Teleport to Anachronia and run north.

sub.t: Fastest way to get there is by using the War's Retreat boss portal / the Max Guild boss portal or the Grouping System teleporting to Rex Matriarchs and heading west to the Teleportation Device and activating it, taking you where you need to be.
Alternatively, leave Anachronia base camp through the southern exit and head north-east to central Anachronia

steps.t: Find all four frogs.
Finish the dialogue with Prehistoric Potterington.
Teleport back to Burthorpe and speak to the Curator. [Chat: ? Talk about Desperate Creatures. › 1 Talk about your progress.]
Speak to Seren on the floor 2 of the Burthorpe Castle. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Desperate Creatures'.]
Go downstairs, head south and speak to the Curator. [Chat: ? Talk about 'Desperate Creatures'.]
